properties.description: This pipeline copies the data (parquet files) from our ADLS container to External Unity Catalog Tables

activities.name: Step Start
activities.description: Marks the Raw to Replica step as in-progress by inserting a new run record into STEP_RUN_TBL, updating STEP_STS_CD to in-progress in STEP_CTRL_TBL, and returning STEP_RUN_SK and CYC_RUN_SK for use by downstream activities.

activities.name: Populate Table List for Raw to Replica Load
activities.description: Clears and repopulates TABLES_TO_LOAD_RPL with all active tables that have completed the Source to ADLS load, providing the ForEach activity with the list of tables to process in the Raw to Replica step.

activities.name: Get Tables for Raw to Replica Load
activities.description: Retrieves the list of tables to be processed in the Raw to Replica step from TABLES_TO_LOAD_RPL, providing the ForEach activity with the table name, job details, and cycle run reference for each table.

dependsOn.activity: Populate Table List for Raw to Replica Load

sqlReaderQuery.value: SELECT TGT_FILE_TBL, JOB_SK, STEP_SK, CYC_RUN_SK FROM @{pipeline().parameters.ASQL_SCHEMA}.TABLES_TO_LOAD_RPL WHERE XCENTER='@{pipeline().parameters.XCENTER}'

dependsOn.activity: Get Tables for Raw to Replica Load

items.value: @activity('Get Tables for Raw to Replica Load').output.value

activities.name: Job Start
activities.description: Marks the current table's job as in-progress in JOB_CTRL_TBL and opens a tracking record in JOB_RUN_TBL. Returns JOB_RUN_SK for use by downstream activities.

activities.name: ADLS Raw Parquet to Replica External Delta Tables
activities.description: Reads pending parquet files from ADLS raw/, applies CDC logic (MERGE inserts/updates, soft-delete deletes), and loads the results into external Delta tables registered in Unity Catalog under replica schema.

activities.name: Replica Table Balancing Part 1
activities.description:
Here we are confirming that the replica Delta tables received exactly what was in the raw parquet - no rows dropped, no rows duplicated silently.

- Reads raw parquet from ADLS, deduplicate it, and stage the result as global temp views for downstream balance reconciliation.
- For tables loaded in the current cycle, raw parquet is read from ADLS, deduplicated, and staged as global_temp.{table}_source. For tables not loaded in the current cycle, the prior balance_recon Delta table is used as a fallback to ensure downstream reconciliation can still run.
- No writes, no metrics, no reconciliation — source prep only.

dependsOn.activity: Get Tables for Raw to Replica Load

activities.name: Replica Table Balancing Part 2
activities.description:
Here we are confirming that the replica Delta tables received exactly what was in the raw parquet - no rows dropped, no rows duplicated silently.

- Reads raw parquet from ADLS, deduplicate it, and stage the result as global temp views for downstream balance reconciliation.
- For tables loaded in the current cycle, raw parquet is read from ADLS, deduplicated, and staged as global_temp.{table}_source. For tables not loaded in the current cycle, the prior balance_recon Delta table is used as a fallback to ensure downstream reconciliation can still run.
- No writes, no metrics, no reconciliation — source prep only.

dependsOn.activity: Get Tables for Raw to Replica Load

activities.name: Replica Table Balancing - Final Reconciliation
activities.description:
- While the ForEach is busy loading replica tables (notebook 07), notebooks 08 and 09 are simultaneously reading and deduplicating raw parquet for their specific assigned tables into global temp views — 08 handles cc_claim and cc_transaction, 09 handles cc_policy, cc_exposure and cc_contact
- Only these tables are prepped because they are the key financial tables needed to compute the 5 balance metrics — the other tables are loaded by the ForEach but don't need to be reconciled
- By the time the ForEach finishes, all source views are already prepared
- Notebook 10 then immediately compares source vs replica — no waiting needed
- This is why 08 and 09 run in parallel with the ForEach, not after it
